name: Borghetto Santo Spirito (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Borghetto Santo Spirito (a dove above a red cross on yellow) within branches, with the motto UNIVERSITAS BURGETI 1294 on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Borghetto Santo Spirito, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Borghetto Santo Spirito arms — dove above a red cross on yellow, crowned, within branches, with scroll UNIVERSITAS BURGETI 1294
